snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Pulsing Aura 👊 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to punch up your collection with the newest Pokémon TCG Pocket expansion, Pulsing Aura! 👊💥

Check out the debut of Mega Lucario ex, Mega Sceptile ex, and more. Plus, gold frames will be available as a type of flair for ◆, ◆◆, and ◆◆◆ rarity cards in every series! Launches April 27!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
